text:
emma: FYI I'm taking a 10-week remote stay in Lisbon starting 2026-07-05. Need to confirm WFH stipend proration, whether my homebase should change, payroll withholding, and if health plan covers emergencies there. Also can we ship my standing desk riser?

diego: If you keep homebase as NY and stay <183 days, payroll usually stays US. I'll check Chile/Portugal rules for any local registration but 10 weeks typically fine.

courtney: Stipend is prorated by full months. For 10 weeks that's usually 2 full months (we prorate by whole months only). Submit via Expensify with "WFH stipend - prorated" and dates.

emma: Good to know. Is equipment shipping allowed internationally? I'll need the desk riser.

courtney: We can ship, but you must cover customs/duties. Complete the equipment shipping form and include asset tag. Link: https://redwood.example.com/hr/equipment-shipping

payroll-bot: Automated: log a Temporary Address in Homebase at least 7 days before departure to ensure payroll/address flags are correct. See our temp remote guide.

ben: Benefits: our US medical plan covers emergency care worldwide for short trips; routine care abroad is not covered. We recommend travel insurance for non-emergency needs. I'll DM recommended vendors.

diego: Also avoid client-facing or hiring activities while abroad without legal sign-off; that can trigger local obligations. I'll loop in legal if you plan that.

emma: Thanks all, I'll submit the HRIS temp address and expense request this week.
